Index.meta_title: Marksheet: every test, graded on one card
Index.meta_description: Log what you tested, how it went and when. A sample product built on the Next.js + Spring Boilerplate.
Index.title: Every test, graded on one card.
Index.intro: Log what you tested, how it went and when. Marksheet keeps every mark in one place, so you can see what passed at a glance.
Index.remark: Strong term. Retake the Spanish listening part.
Index.key_title: Three marks, read in one look
Index.key_intro: Every result gets one mark. Scan down the column and you know where you stand.
Index.key_failed: A circle: it failed and wants another go.
Index.key_pending: An open box: still waiting on the result.
Index.rows_intro: Five fields, the same every time, so every row lines up with the last.
Index.row_name_desc: What you tested, in your own words. Up to 100 characters.
Index.row_score_desc: A mark from 0 to 100. Decimals are fine.
Index.row_tested_at_desc: When the test happened, to the minute.
Index.row_notes_desc: A remark for later. Optional, up to 1,000 characters.
Index.features_title: Kept the way a card should be
Index.feature_totals: Counts for each mark, updated the moment you add a row.
Index.feature_history: Every result you have logged, most recent test first, ten to a page.
Index.feature_private: Each account sees only its own results. Your session lives on the server, never in the browser's JavaScript.
Index.feature_languages: Switch language from any page and the card follows.
Index.close_text: Create an account, log your first test and watch the mark go on.

About.meta_description: About Marksheet and the template it is built on
About.title: About this template
About.about_paragraph: Marksheet is a sample product. It shows what a frontend built on the spring-postgres-boilerplate API looks like when it is finished: a landing page, sign-in, and an app working on real data.
About.replace_paragraph: To start your own product, replace the Marksheet copy in src/locales and swap the test-results example for your own domain.
About.feature_auth: Sign up, sign in and sign out with the backend's JWT and rotating refresh tokens, kept in httpOnly cookies
About.feature_api: A typed API client generated from the backend's OpenAPI spec
About.feature_ui: Shared UI components from shadcn/ui, themed with design tokens
About.feature_quality: Lint, type checks, unit tests and full-stack end-to-end tests in CI
About.credits: Based on <upstream>Next.js Boilerplate</upstream> by ixartz (MIT licence).
